enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner set to a moderate cooling temperature
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow with hand. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back up. Reach for air conditioner remote on nightstand. Press button to lower temperature. Place remote back. Turn to left side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a quick cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes and sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower tap and adjust to cool. Step into shower. Wet body and apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off tap. Grab towel and dry body. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, drinking cold water to stay hydrated before the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Pour cereal and milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink cold water. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes and checking the phone for shift messages and the heatwave warning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Put on shirt and pants. Put on socks and shoes. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Read shift messages. Open weather app. Read heatwave warning. Put phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of bedroom. Walk to front door. Pick up keys. Open front door. Step outside. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Arrive at hospital stop. Stand up. Walk to bus exit. Step off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to ward. Pick up clipboard. Review patient charts. Enter patient room 1. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Write notes on chart. Move to patient room 2. Assist patient with mobility. Change wound dressing. Respond to call light. Walk to nurses' station. Answer phone. Enter data into computer. Consult with doctor. Attend to patient in room 3. Escort patient to bathroom. Return to nurses' station.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and drinking fluids during the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select sandwich. Pick up water bottle. Pay at cashier. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Return tray.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work, patient care and charting at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room 4. Check blood pressure. Empty catheter bag. Administer injection. Update chart. Walk to supply room. Restock gloves. Return to ward. Assist patient with meal. Document intake. Respond to emergency call. Rush to patient room 5. Assist in CPR. Clean equipment. Discuss with team. Write shift report. Handover to next shift. Organize files. Sanitize hands. Walk to locker room.

Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Arrive at home stop. Stand up. Walk to bus exit. Step off bus. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables and meat. Stir with spatula. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up dishes and putting leftovers in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape leftovers into container. Cover container. Open refrigerator. Place container inside. Close refrigerator. Pick up dishes. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and wiping down after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water to cool. Step into shower. Wet body and apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off tap. Grab towel and dry body. Wipe down shower walls. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Connect to Wi-Fi. Browse websites. Type on keyboard. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up to get snack. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Continue browsing.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet leisure time reading and hydrating before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up book from table. Open book to bookmark. Read pages. Turn page. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put glass down. Continue reading. Adjust sitting position. Turn on lamp. Read more pages. Close book. Put book down. Pick up glass. Drink water. Stand up. Stretch arms. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to bed and sleeping with the fan and air conditioner on for the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on fan. Pick up air conditioner remote. Turn on air conditioner. Set temperature to cool. Place remote on nightstand. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Adjust fan speed. Turn to back. Breathe slowly. Sleep.
